_comment: Patches for the landing page (pages_original/index.html). Format: site/patches/README.md

steps.why: rewrite the design-time file names to the pages of the site
header: Materials link
header: Inspiration link
header: Finder link
header: My project link
menu: Materials and My project cards
steps.anchor: Upload a photo of your space and see it in Terucon materials.

steps.why: hero: a plain way into the Design Studio that is visible without opening the menu (also on a phone)
start the Design Studio's cold start as soon as the landing page opens
footer: Shop materials and My project links
hide the design-review media pill (its target file does not exist)
retarget the hidden media pill (no dead link left in the page)

PostHog analytics: page views, clicks and forms, and (studio page) the studio's own events, which its browser code sends to window.posthog but its server never gives a key for. The script asks GET /api/analytics, so no key is in the page

sign-in: the header link says Sign in or Account, and a request answered "please sign in" (the session ended) leads to the sign-in page. The script asks GET /api/auth/me, so nothing about the visitor is in the page
header: the real logo (in a dark pill, so it reads on the cream sections too) instead of the typed TERUCON INDIA
menu overlay: the real logo (the overlay is dark, no pill)
footer: the full lockup (emblem, name, INDIA PVT. LTD., tagline) above the columns, and a little less space above the columns
header on a phone: less padding so the sticky bar takes 62 px, not 78
pinned scenes fill the visible screen on a phone (100dvh), not the screen with the browser bars hidden (100vh); 100vh stays as the fallback
menu overlay on a phone: start at the top with tighter gaps (the overlay scrolls)
menu overlay: on a phone the five destinations come first as large tap targets, then Sign in / Account and Start a project; the in-page sections follow
menu overlay on a phone: a small heading over the in-page sections
menu overlay on a phone: the in-page sections are smaller than the destinations (and still 44 px tall)
menu overlay on a phone: the Design Studio card is replaced by the destinations list above (it stays on a laptop)
hero and craft films: do not preload (the loader below starts them after the page has loaded, and not at all on a phone)
films: decide once whether this visitor gets the film (a phone, data saver, reduced motion or a slow connection get the poster picture only); show the poster at once
steps.anchor: if (vh.dataset.poster) { const pi = new Image(); pi.onload = () => { v.poster = vh.dataset.poster; }; pi.src = vh.dataset.poster; }

steps.why: films: start downloading only after the window load event, so they never compete with the page itself
steps.with: if (!lite) { const go = () => { v.src = vh.dataset.video; }; if (document.readyState === 'complete') setTimeout(go, 300); else addEventListener('load', () => setTimeout(go, 300), { once: true }); }

steps.why: the three big "shell to handover" pictures are fetched when the visitor is about 1500 px away from them, not all at page load

mobile dock: the bottom bar with the five destinations on a phone (site/brand/dock.md)

header between 820 and 1199 px: links stay on one line (they wrapped once the real logo replaced the typed one); between 820 and 899 the dock carries the destinations; the hero buttons stay clear of the bottom bar; room under the footer for the bottom bar; 44 px tap targets on a phone
insert:
<style>
/* header links on a narrow laptop or a tablet: one line each; the phone dock (up to 899 px) already carries the destinations */
[data-nav] nav a { white-space: nowrap; }
@media (min-width: 820px) and (max-width: 899px) { [data-nav] nav > a:not([data-navpill]) { display: none !important; } }
@media (min-width: 900px) and (max-width: 1199px) {
  [data-nav] nav { gap: 14px !important; }
  [data-nav] nav a[data-terucon-account], [data-nav] nav > a[href="/design-studio"] > span { display: none !important; }
}
/* the hero's buttons stay clear of the bottom bar */
@media (max-width: 899px) {
  [data-hero-copy] { bottom: calc(var(--tc-dock-h, 0px) + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px) + 24px) !important; }
  [data-cue] { display: none !important; }
}
/* room under the footer for the bottom bar (the body is only a frame here, so dock.css's own spacer would sit mid-page) */
@media (max-width: 899px) {
  body::after { display: none !important; }
  .tc-dock-on [data-root] { padding-bottom: calc(var(--tc-dock-h, 0px) + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px)); }
}
/* tap targets: 44 px on a phone or a small tablet (links in the footer and the contact lines, the material list, the menu buttons) */
@media (max-width: 899px) {
  footer a, a[href^="tel:"], a[href^="mailto:"], a[href*="wa.me"] { display: inline-flex !important; align-items: center; min-height: 44px !important; }
  [data-menu-btn], [data-menu-close], [data-totop], [data-finish], [data-mat] { min-height: 44px !important; }
  [data-fcol] { gap: 0 !important; }
  [data-hero-copy] a[href="#work"] { position: relative; }
  [data-hero-copy] a[href="#work"]::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: -10px; right: -10px; top: -14px; bottom: -14px; }
}
</style>
